nodes.body: With reuse enabled, this cache has no row/byte bound and retains every materialized RHS for every non-bind pattern reached by any block until the capped call returns. A capped miss over a multi-pattern graph can therefore keep the full relations for all reached patterns live at once, whereas the previous per-block path released each RHS after the join; because `budget::active()` is false for ordinary unbudgeted queries, this can turn a LIMIT/ASK optimization into an OOM/peak-memory regression. Please add a bounded/evicting policy (or restrict reuse to a proven small set) and a large-pattern allocation/peak-memory test before enabling it by default.
